policy: Exact repeated prose is not approved by default. Every approved cross-page duplicate requires a stable exact normalised_text key and a reason. Unused entries are reported for cleanup.

approved.normalised_text: prototype not a released game saved in this browser only
approved.reason: This is a required per-route truth notice on standalone game prototype pages. Each route must independently disclose that the game is not released and its state is browser-local; removing the notice from individual game pages would misrepresent release and persistence status.

approved.normalised_text: stored only in this browser not synced to your account clearing browser data or switching devices loses it export a backup periodically
approved.reason: Required per-page disclosure: this financial workspace stores the displayed records in browser-local storage and the user must be warned about device loss and backup before entering or relying on those records. Removing it from any standalone finance route would hide a material persistence limitation.
